Interface TaskbarStatus

All Known Implementing Classes:
FakeTaskbar
public interface TaskbarStatus
The application's entry in the taskbar, or its Dock icon: a progress, a badge, and requests for the user's attention. Its methods may be called from any thread, and are applied on the EDT. Each uses the features of java.awt.Taskbar that the system supports, and does nothing when it supports none.

While a task blocks the application (Block.APPLICATION), the taskbar shows its progress.

The UI module provides it as a singleton; the test harness replaces it with a fake that records the state.
